build_riformer_backbone: build a RIFormer backbone model with architecture s12 for image feature extraction
create_riformerblock: create a RIFormerBlock with specified embedding dimension and MLP ratio for residual learning
switch_to_deploy_mode: switch a RIFormer model to deployment mode by fusing affine and norm layers
freeze_riformer_stages: freeze early stages of a RIFormer backbone to prevent gradient updates during fine-tuning
generate_basic_blocks: generate a sequence of RIFormer blocks for a specific stage with drop path rate
